S1.2.why: src/queries/customer_totals.py does the grouping, sum, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT/OFFSET and a count(*) total in SQL; src/web/staff_pages.py only maps rows.

S1.5.why: src/queries/customer_list.py selects the persisted loyalty_tier column; the rule is applied only in src/core/customers.py (via core/loyalty.py) on place, cancel, suspend and reinstate, and saved by pg_customers.py. No query code evaluates it.

S2.3.why: src/adapters/revenue_projection.py docstring declares trigger (same transaction as the invoice command), staleness (none, synchronous), idempotency key (invoice_id, change) and rebuild (python3 -m src.adapters.revenue_projection). The schema backs the key, and read-your-own-writes is not needed because the projection is synchronous.

S4.1.why: src/core/commands/change_shipping_address.py takes only order_id, street, city and postcode, and returns order.version. It is wired through main.py and web/order_pages.py post_shipping_address.
